analogy.rationale: CDC25 phosphatases activate CDKs and are checkpoint effectors, so CDK and CHK inhibitors perturb the same cell-cycle machinery and should yield similar transcriptional responses; PLK/Aurora inhibitors and DNA synthesis inhibitors converge on related mitotic/DNA-replication arrest programs.
